bank.name: Grammar
bank.subject: English
bank.description: Parts of speech, tenses, subject-verb agreement, articles, prepositions and sentence structure.

questions.prompt: She ___ to school every day.
questions.explanation: Third-person singular needs 'goes' in the simple present tense.

questions.prompt: Choose the past tense of 'go'.
questions.explanation: 'Went' is the simple past of 'go'.

questions.prompt: I have ___ my homework.
questions.explanation: Present perfect takes the past participle 'done'.

questions.prompt: He ___ playing football right now.
questions.explanation: Present continuous uses 'is' with a singular subject.

questions.prompt: A noun is a word that names?
options: A person, place, thing or idea
questions.explanation: Nouns name people, places, things or ideas.

questions.prompt: An adjective is a word that describes a?
questions.explanation: Adjectives modify nouns or pronouns.

questions.prompt: An adverb most often modifies a?
questions.explanation: Adverbs modify verbs, adjectives or other adverbs.

questions.prompt: Which is the correct article for '___ apple'?
questions.explanation: 'Apple' begins with a vowel sound, so we use 'an'.

questions.prompt: Which article is used before 'hour'?
questions.explanation: 'Hour' begins with a vowel sound (silent h), so 'an hour'.

questions.prompt: The plural of 'child' is?
questions.explanation: 'Children' is the irregular plural of 'child'.

questions.prompt: The plural of 'mouse' (the animal) is?
questions.explanation: 'Mice' is the irregular plural of 'mouse'.

questions.prompt: Which word has the same form in singular and plural?
questions.explanation: 'Sheep' stays 'sheep' in the plural.

questions.prompt: He is good ___ mathematics.
questions.explanation: We say 'good at' a subject or skill.

questions.prompt: She is afraid ___ dogs.
questions.explanation: 'Afraid of' is the correct collocation.

questions.prompt: We arrived ___ Lahore at noon.
questions.explanation: We use 'in' before cities and countries: arrive in Lahore.

questions.prompt: The cat is sitting ___ the table.
questions.explanation: 'On' is used for a surface.

questions.prompt: The present continuous tense is formed with?
questions.explanation: Present continuous = be verb + present participle.

questions.prompt: If it rains, we ___ at home.
questions.explanation: First conditional: if + present, will + base verb.

questions.prompt: The letter ___ by him yesterday.
questions.explanation: Passive voice in the past: 'was written'.

questions.prompt: He said, 'I am tired.' In reported speech: He said that he ___ tired.
questions.explanation: The present 'am' shifts to past 'was' in indirect speech.

questions.prompt: Which of the following is a conjunction?
questions.explanation: 'Because' connects clauses; it is a conjunction.

questions.prompt: She is taller ___ her sister.
questions.explanation: Comparatives use 'than'.

questions.prompt: Neither he ___ I was present.
questions.explanation: 'Neither...nor' is the correct pair.

questions.prompt: There ___ many students in the hall.
questions.explanation: 'Students' is plural, so 'are' is used.

questions.prompt: The news ___ very good.
questions.explanation: 'News' is uncountable and takes a singular verb.

questions.prompt: Each of the boys ___ completed the work.
questions.explanation: 'Each' is singular and takes 'has'.

questions.prompt: I look forward ___ hearing from you.
questions.explanation: 'Look forward to' takes the -ing form.

questions.prompt: He is interested ___ history.
questions.explanation: 'Interested in' is the correct collocation.

questions.prompt: In 'Swimming is good exercise', the word 'Swimming' is a?
questions.explanation: A gerund is an -ing verb form used as a noun.

questions.prompt: Which form is an infinitive?
questions.explanation: The infinitive is 'to' + base verb.

questions.prompt: ___ did you see at the party?
questions.explanation: 'Whom' is the object form: you saw him/her.

questions.prompt: ___ raining heavily outside.
questions.explanation: 'It's' is the contraction of 'it is'.

questions.prompt: She is coming tomorrow, ___?
questions.explanation: Positive statement takes a negative tag question.

questions.prompt: Hardly had he arrived ___ it started to rain.
questions.explanation: 'Hardly...when' is the correct correlative pair.

questions.prompt: No sooner had he left ___ the phone rang.
questions.explanation: 'No sooner...than' is the correct correlative pair.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is in the imperative mood?
questions.explanation: An imperative gives a command or request.

questions.prompt: The superlative degree of 'good' is?
questions.explanation: Good - better - best is the correct sequence.

questions.prompt: The comparative degree of 'bad' is?
questions.explanation: Bad - worse - worst.

questions.prompt: A sentence that expresses a strong emotion ends with?
questions.explanation: Exclamatory sentences end with an exclamation mark.

questions.prompt: 'The, a, an' are known as?
questions.explanation: 'The' is the definite article; 'a/an' are indefinite articles.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence:
options: She has gone to school yesterday
She has went to school yesterday
She had go to school yesterday
questions.explanation: 'Yesterday' requires the simple past tense, so 'went' is correct; 'has gone' needs no time adverb.

questions.prompt: Complete: If I _____ rich, I would travel the world.
questions.explanation: Second conditional uses 'were' for all persons: If I were rich, I would travel.

questions.prompt: Which word is a conjunction?
questions.explanation: 'Although' is a subordinating conjunction; quickly is an adverb, under a preposition, beautiful an adjective.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct passive form: 'They are building a new bridge.'
options: A new bridge is being built
A new bridge was being built
questions.explanation: Present continuous passive: am/is/are + being + past participle → 'is being built'.

questions.prompt: Identify the correct conditional: '_____ you study, you will pass.'
questions.explanation: 'Unless' means 'if not': 'Unless you study, you will pass' means 'If you do not study, you will not pass'.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank: The committee _____ divided on the issue.
questions.explanation: Collective noun 'committee' treated as a single unit takes a singular verb: 'is divided'.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct comparative: This is _____ than the other option.
questions.explanation: 'Good' has the irregular comparative 'better' and superlative 'best'.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is in the future perfect tense?
options: I will have finished by noon
questions.explanation: Future perfect uses 'will have + past participle' to express completion before a future time.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct preposition: She is good _____ mathematics.
questions.explanation: The idiom is 'good at' something.

questions.prompt: Identify the adverb in: 'He spoke very softly.'
questions.explanation: 'Softly' modifies the verb 'spoke' and is the adverb; 'very' is an intensifier.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct indirect speech: He said, 'I am busy.'
options: He said that he was busy
He said that I am busy
He says that he was busy
He told that he is busy
questions.explanation: In reported speech the present 'am' shifts back to past 'was'.

questions.prompt: Which word is an interjection?
questions.explanation: 'Wow' expresses sudden emotion and is an interjection.

questions.prompt: Complete: Neither the students nor the teacher _____ present.
questions.explanation: With 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject: 'the teacher' → singular 'was'.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: He is senior _____ me.
questions.explanation: Latin-origin comparatives like 'senior', 'junior', 'inferior' take 'to', not 'than'.

questions.prompt: Which sentence uses the past perfect correctly?
options: The train had left before we arrived
The train left before we had arrived
The train has left before we arrived
The train had leave before we arrived
questions.explanation: Past perfect (had left) shows the earlier action; simple past (arrived) shows the later one.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence:
questions.explanation: 'Since 2010' (point in time) with present perfect: 'have lived'.

questions.prompt: Complete: She _____ to the market when I saw her.
questions.explanation: An action in progress in the past → past continuous 'was going'.

questions.prompt: Which word is a verb?
questions.explanation: 'Run' is a verb; beautiful is an adjective, quickly an adverb, under a preposition.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct article: He is _____ honest man.
questions.explanation: 'Honest' begins with a vowel sound, so 'an' is used.

questions.prompt: Complete: By next year, I _____ in this city for ten years.
questions.explanation: Future perfect: 'will have lived' expresses completion by a future time.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is in the passive voice?
options: The letter was written by Ali
questions.explanation: Passive voice: subject receives the action — 'The letter was written'.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: Would you mind _____ the window?
questions.explanation: 'Would you mind' is followed by a gerund (-ing form).

questions.prompt: Identify the pronoun in: 'Ali and I are friends.'
questions.explanation: 'I' is a personal pronoun; Ali is a noun.

questions.prompt: Complete: He is fond _____ classical music.
questions.explanation: The adjective 'fond' takes the preposition 'of'.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question tag: She is coming, _____?
questions.explanation: Positive statement takes a negative tag: 'isn't she'.

questions.prompt: Which word is a collective noun?
questions.explanation: 'Flock' is a collective noun naming a group (of birds/sheep).

questions.prompt: Complete: No sooner did he arrive _____ it started raining.
questions.explanation: 'No sooner...than' is the correct correlative pair with inversion.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct plural: The _____ are grazing in the field.
questions.explanation: 'Sheep' has the same form in singular and plural.

questions.prompt: Identify the type of sentence: 'Please close the door.'
questions.explanation: A command or request is an imperative sentence.

questions.prompt: Complete: Each of the boys _____ given a prize.
questions.explanation: 'Each' is singular and takes a singular verb: 'was given'.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: He is looking forward _____ you.
questions.explanation: 'Look forward to' is followed by a gerund: 'to meeting'.

questions.prompt: Which sentence uses a comparative adjective?
options: She is taller than her sister
questions.explanation: 'Taller than' compares two people — the comparative form.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct preposition: The cat jumped _____ the table.
questions.explanation: 'Jumped onto the table' describes movement to a surface.

questions.prompt: Complete: I wish I _____ more time yesterday.
questions.explanation: Wishing about the past uses past perfect: 'had had'.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct indirect speech: She said, 'I will come tomorrow.'
options: She said that she would come the next day
She said that she will come tomorrow
She said that she would come tomorrow
She says that she would come next day
questions.explanation: 'Will' shifts to 'would' and 'tomorrow' to 'the next day' in reported speech.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: He speaks English _____.
questions.explanation: 'Fluently' is the adverb modifying the verb 'speaks'.

questions.prompt: Complete: If you had studied, you _____ the exam.
questions.explanation: Third conditional: 'If + past perfect, would have + past participle'.

questions.prompt: Which word is an abstract noun?
questions.explanation: Abstract nouns name ideas/qualities — 'happiness' is one.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct determiner: There is _____ milk in the glass.
questions.explanation: 'Milk' is uncountable, so 'some' (not many/a few) is correct.

questions.prompt: Complete: The harder you work, _____ you will succeed.
questions.explanation: Correlative 'the + comparative, the + comparative': 'the more likely'.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is correct?
questions.explanation: 'Cousin brother' is an Indian English error; simply 'my cousin' is correct.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: It is high time you _____ your habits.
questions.explanation: 'It is high time' is followed by past subjunctive: 'you changed'.

questions.prompt: Complete: Neither Ali nor his friends _____ invited.
questions.explanation: With 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject (friends) → 'were'.

questions.prompt: Which word is a linking verb?
questions.explanation: 'Seems' links the subject to a complement; the others are action verbs.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: He is better _____ than his brother.
questions.explanation: 'Better at' + activity is the correct idiom.

questions.prompt: Complete: _____ the weather was bad, we went out.
questions.explanation: 'Although' introduces a contrast: bad weather yet we went out.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct tag: They haven't finished, _____?
questions.explanation: Negative statement takes a positive tag: 'have they'.

questions.prompt: Identify the participle in: 'The broken window needs repair.'
questions.explanation: 'Broken' is a past participle used as an adjective.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct order: He is a _____ boy.
questions.explanation: Opinion→size→age order: 'tall, young, handsome' fits adjective sequencing.

questions.prompt: Complete: He talks as if he _____ everything.
questions.explanation: 'As if' takes the past subjunctive 'knew' for unreal situations.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: I _____ her for a long time.
questions.explanation: 'Know' is a state verb and with 'for a long time' we use present perfect: 'have known'.

questions.prompt: Complete: The book _____ on the table belongs to Ali.
questions.explanation: 'Lying' is the present participle of 'lie' (be in a horizontal position); 'laying' needs an object.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence:
options: He is one of the best players in the team
He is one of the best player in the team
He is the one of best players
He is one of best players
questions.explanation: 'One of the + superlative + plural noun' is the correct structure.

questions.prompt: Complete: He did not go to school, _____?
questions.explanation: Negative statement takes a positive tag: 'did he'.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct preposition: He is good _____ painting.
questions.explanation: 'Good at' + activity is the correct idiom.

questions.prompt: Complete: I have been working here _____ 2015.
questions.explanation: 'Since' is used with a point in time (2015).

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: She enjoys _____ novels.
questions.explanation: 'Enjoy' is followed by a gerund: 'enjoys reading'.

questions.prompt: Complete: _____ I reached the station, the train had left.
questions.explanation: 'When' introduces the later action; the past perfect shows the earlier one.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: He is the _____ of the two.
questions.explanation: Comparing two people uses the comparative 'taller'.

questions.prompt: Complete: She asked me if I _____ help her.
questions.explanation: In reported speech 'can' shifts to 'could'.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence:
options: There is many water in the glass
There is much water in the glass
There are much water in the glass
There is many waters in the glass
questions.explanation: 'Water' is uncountable → 'much water' with singular 'is'.

questions.prompt: Complete: It is I who _____ responsible.
questions.explanation: 'It is I who' takes the first person verb: 'am responsible'.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: This is the house _____ I was born.
questions.explanation: 'Where' is the relative adverb for a place.

questions.prompt: Complete: He has been absent _____ Monday.
questions.explanation: 'Since' is used with a specific starting point (Monday).

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence:
questions.explanation: 'Police' is a plural collective noun: 'The police are coming'.

questions.prompt: Complete: Hardly had he left _____ it started raining.
questions.explanation: 'Hardly...when' is the correct pair, not 'hardly...than'.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: I would rather _____ at home than go out.
questions.explanation: 'Would rather' is followed by the base form of the verb.

questions.prompt: Complete: The number of students _____ increasing.
questions.explanation: 'The number of' is singular → 'is increasing'.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence:
options: He came yesterday and went away
He came yesterday and has gone away
He had come yesterday and went away
He comes yesterday and went away
questions.explanation: Both actions happened in the past → simple past for both.

questions.prompt: Complete: _____ he is rich, he is not happy.
questions.explanation: 'Although' introduces a contrast: rich but unhappy.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: The teacher, along with the students, _____ going.
questions.explanation: 'Along with' doesn't change the subject: subject is 'teacher' (singular) → 'is'.

questions.prompt: Complete: I _____ him since our school days.
questions.explanation: 'Since our school days' with a continuing state → present perfect 'have known'.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence:
questions.explanation: 'Well' is the adverb modifying 'speaks'.

questions.prompt: Complete: She is interested _____ learning Urdu.
questions.explanation: 'Interested in' + gerund is the correct idiom.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: Neither of the answers _____ correct.
questions.explanation: 'Neither' is singular → 'is correct'.

questions.prompt: Complete: He works hard so that he _____ pass.
questions.explanation: 'So that' of purpose is followed by 'may' or 'can'.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence:
options: I have been seeing him yesterday
questions.explanation: 'Yesterday' needs simple past: 'I saw him yesterday'.

questions.prompt: Complete: He is senior _____ me by two years.
questions.explanation: 'Senior' takes 'to', not 'than'.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: It is time we _____ home.
questions.explanation: 'It is time' is followed by the past subjunctive: 'we went'.

questions.prompt: Complete: _____ the teacher entered, the students stood up.
questions.explanation: 'As soon as' expresses two actions happening in quick succession.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence:
options: He asked me what my name was
He asked me what was my name
He asked me what my name is
He asked that what my name was
questions.explanation: Indirect questions keep statement word order: 'what my name was'.

questions.prompt: Complete: She has been teaching _____ ten years.
questions.explanation: 'For' is used with a duration (ten years).

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: If he had come, I _____ him.
questions.explanation: Third conditional: 'would have + past participle'.

questions.prompt: Complete: He is capable _____ doing the work.
questions.explanation: 'Capable of' + gerund is the correct idiom.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence:
options: Each of the boys were present
Each of the boys was present
Each of the boys have been present
questions.explanation: 'Each' takes a singular verb: 'was present'.

questions.prompt: Complete: No sooner had he seen me _____ he ran away.
questions.explanation: 'No sooner...than' is the correct correlative.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: There are _____ apples on the table.
questions.explanation: 'Apples' is plural countable → 'some'.

questions.prompt: Complete: He is used to _____ early.
questions.explanation: 'Used to' + gerund expresses a habit: 'used to getting up'.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence:
options: He asked me to not go there
He asked me not to go there
He asked me not go there
He asked me to not going there
questions.explanation: Negative infinitive: 'not to go'.

questions.prompt: Complete: She sings _____ than her sister.
questions.explanation: Comparing two people → comparative 'better'.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: He does not know _____ to do.
questions.explanation: 'What' is the interrogative pronoun for an unknown thing.

questions.prompt: Complete: If you heat ice, it _____.
questions.explanation: Zero conditional (general truth): simple present in both clauses.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence:
questions.explanation: 'Afraid of' is the correct preposition.

questions.prompt: Complete: She prefers tea _____ coffee.
questions.explanation: 'Prefer X to Y' is the correct structure.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: He is the man _____ I met yesterday.
questions.explanation: 'Whom' is the object of 'met'.

questions.prompt: Complete: _____ you work hard, you will not pass.
questions.explanation: 'Unless' means 'if not': unless you work hard, you will not pass.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence:
options: He has visited Multan last week
He has been visiting Multan last week
questions.explanation: 'Last week' is a definite past time → simple past.

questions.prompt: Complete: The scenery of Hunza _____ breathtaking.
questions.explanation: 'Scenery' is uncountable → singular verb 'is'.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: He went to bed after he _____ his homework.
questions.explanation: Earlier action in the past → past perfect 'had finished'.

questions.prompt: Complete: Not only did he fail, _____ he lost his scholarship.
questions.explanation: 'Not only...but (also)' is the correct correlative pair.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: He has been living here _____ 2010.
questions.explanation: 'Since' is used with a point in time (2010).

questions.prompt: Complete: The committee _____ not yet reached a decision.
questions.explanation: 'Committee' as a single unit takes a singular verb: 'has'.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence:
options: He asked me where I was going
He asked me where was I going
He asked me where I am going
He asked that where I was going
questions.explanation: Indirect questions use statement word order: 'where I was going'.

questions.prompt: Complete: She is very good _____ mathematics.
questions.explanation: 'Good at' + subject is the correct idiom.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: I wish I _____ more careful.
questions.explanation: Regret about the past → past perfect: 'had been'.

questions.prompt: Complete: This is the girl _____ father is a doctor.
questions.explanation: 'Whose' shows possession: 'the girl whose father'.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence:
options: He is taller than any other boy in the class
He is taller than any boy in the class
He is tallest than any boy
He is more tall than any boy
questions.explanation: For comparison within a group, use 'taller than any other boy'.

questions.prompt: Complete: He insisted _____ paying the bill.
questions.explanation: 'Insist on' + gerund is the correct idiom.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: I have known him _____ ten years.
questions.explanation: 'For' is used with a duration (ten years).

questions.prompt: Complete: _____ you like it or not, you must go.
questions.explanation: 'Whether...or not' expresses alternatives.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence:
questions.explanation: 'Suffer from' + illness is the correct idiom.

questions.prompt: Complete: He is confident _____ success.
questions.explanation: 'Confident of' + noun is the correct idiom.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: He speaks English _____ than his sister.
questions.explanation: Comparing two people → comparative adverb 'more fluently'.

questions.prompt: Complete: Hardly had we started _____ it began to rain.
questions.explanation: 'Hardly...when' is the correct pair.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence:
options: He is married to a doctor
He is married with a doctor
He is married from a doctor
He is married at a doctor
questions.explanation: 'Married to' is the correct idiom.

questions.prompt: Complete: The train had left _____ we reached the station.
questions.explanation: 'Before' shows the past perfect action came first.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: Neither of them _____ present.
questions.explanation: 'Neither' is singular → 'was present'.

questions.prompt: Complete: She is junior _____ him in service.
questions.explanation: 'Junior' takes 'to', like senior/inferior.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence:
options: He has returned back from Lahore
He has returned back to Lahore
He has returned from back Lahore
questions.explanation: 'Return' already means 'come back'; 'returned back' is redundant.

questions.prompt: Complete: It has been raining _____ morning.
questions.explanation: 'Since morning' — a point in time.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: He is the _____ of all the students.
questions.explanation: Comparing three or more → superlative 'brightest'.

questions.prompt: Complete: The manager, not the workers, _____ responsible.
questions.explanation: Subject is 'manager' (singular) → 'is responsible'.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence:
options: He has been ill for two weeks
He has been ill since two weeks
He is ill since two weeks
He is being ill for two weeks
questions.explanation: 'For two weeks' (duration) with present perfect.

questions.prompt: Complete: _____ he is clever, he is lazy.
questions.explanation: 'Although' introduces the contrast: clever but lazy.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: Each of the girls _____ her own uniform.
questions.explanation: Each is singular and takes a singular verb: has.

questions.prompt: Complete: He is not only intelligent _____ also hardworking.
questions.explanation: Not only...but also is the correct correlative pair.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence:
options: The boy whom you met is my brother
The boy who you met is my brother
The boy whose you met is my brother
The boy which you met is my brother
questions.explanation: Whom is the object of the verb met.

questions.prompt: Complete: She has been working here _____ five years.
questions.explanation: For is used with a duration such as five years.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: If it rains, the match _____ cancelled.
questions.explanation: First conditional: if + present, will + base verb.

questions.prompt: Complete: He is busy _____ his homework.
questions.explanation: Busy with is the correct idiom.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence:
options: He told me that he would come
He told that he would come
He told to me that he would come
He told me that he will come
questions.explanation: Tell needs an object, and will shifts to would in reported speech.

questions.prompt: Complete: He is looking forward _____ your visit.
questions.explanation: Look forward to is the correct idiom.

questions.prompt: Complete: _____ the students finished, they left the hall.
questions.explanation: After shows that the finished action came first.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence:
options: There are less people here today
There are fewer people here today
There is fewer people here today
There are lesser people here today
questions.explanation: People is plural countable, so fewer is correct.

questions.prompt: Complete: He is senior to me _____ two years.
questions.explanation: Senior by is used with a measure of difference.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence:
options: He is capable for doing the work
He is capable of doing the work
He is capable to doing the work
He is capable in doing the work
questions.explanation: Capable of is the correct idiom.

questions.prompt: Complete: We were prevented _____ attending the function.
questions.explanation: Prevent from is the correct idiom.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence:
options: He is married from a rich family
He is married into a rich family
He is married with a rich family
He is married at a rich family
questions.explanation: Married into is used for joining a family.

questions.prompt: Complete: He is a man _____ great ability.
questions.explanation: A man of ability is the correct phrase.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: I prefer walking _____ riding.
questions.explanation: Prefer X to Y is the correct structure.

questions.prompt: Complete: He is ashamed _____ his conduct.
questions.explanation: Ashamed of is the correct idiom.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence:
options: He is different from his brother
He is different than his brother
He is different to his brother
He is different of his brother
questions.explanation: Different from is the standard idiom.

questions.prompt: Complete: He is angry _____ me for no reason.
questions.explanation: Angry with is used for a person.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: She is anxious _____ her results.
questions.explanation: Anxious about is the correct idiom.

questions.prompt: Complete: He is good _____ solving problems.
questions.explanation: Good at + gerund is the correct idiom.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence:
options: He has been suffering from fever since Monday
He has been suffering with fever since Monday
He has been suffering of fever since Monday
He has been suffering at fever since Monday
questions.explanation: Suffer from is the correct idiom.

questions.prompt: Complete: He is accused _____ theft.
questions.explanation: Accused of is the correct idiom.
